cards.definition_principle: Research a completed-close break of a predeclared range followed by bounded continuation or retest evidence.
valid_conditions: Trend/range regime and all rule parameters are frozen before replay.
failure_conditions: No follow-through, failed retest, stale premium, or adverse costs.
contradictions: Breakout research in other markets does not prove NIFTY option profitability.
when_not_to_use: Never arm or execute from this research card.
cards.paraphrase: A formal continuation hypothesis requiring CITADEL replay, costs, OOS, shadow, and paper evidence.

research_fields.invalidation_logic: close back inside range or structural failure

cards.definition_principle: Research a trade-through followed by completed-close failure back inside a predeclared range, without assuming every failed break reverses.
measurable_predicates: completed close returns inside within fixed window
valid_conditions: Failure and reversal confirmation are separate predicates.
failure_conditions: Price re-accepts outside, target absent, or premium does not confirm.
contradictions: A failed close may become consolidation rather than reversal.
when_not_to_use: Never execute from a named pattern without deterministic revalidation.
cards.paraphrase: Formalize failure and subsequent reversal as separate, testable events.

research_fields.trigger_logic: completed close back inside plus optional retest
research_fields.failure_analysis: chop, re-break, wide spread, late entry

cards.definition_principle: Research a deterministic level trade-through and reclaim sequence while explicitly withholding hidden-order and institutional-causality claims.
valid_conditions: The label describes only observable price sequence.
failure_conditions: No reclaim, stale level, or continuation beyond sweep extreme.
contradictions: CITADEL cannot observe hidden stop inventory.
when_not_to_use: Never assert stop hunting or institutional intent.
cards.exact_locator: Abstract > order clustering and round numbers
cards.paraphrase: Test the price sequence independently of the causal story.

research_fields.failure_analysis: continuation, ambiguous level, hindsight level selection

cards.definition_principle: Research explicit displacement and three-candle gap predicates as price context only; no institutional imbalance claim is accepted.
measurable_predicates: three completed candles satisfy declared gap
valid_conditions: Competing FVG definitions remain separately versioned.
failure_conditions: Gap definition changes, fill occurs before trigger, or no continuation target.
contradictions: No validated CITADEL FVG authority or institutional-causality evidence exists.
when_not_to_use: Never use as production target or trigger in Phase 5A.
cards.paraphrase: Turn discretionary labels into competing numerical research specifications.

research_fields.target_logic: verified structure only, not gap magic
research_fields.failure_analysis: gap fill, no continuation, definition drift

cards.definition_principle: Research explicit zone-origin and invalidation definitions without claiming institutional sponsorship or treating a reaction as guaranteed.
failure_conditions: Zone is redrawn, origin ambiguous, or invalidation absent.
contradictions: Order-block terminology has competing discretionary definitions and no accepted causal authority here.
when_not_to_use: Never use as production evidence before internal validation.
cards.paraphrase: Specify zones mechanically and test all touches, failures, and costs.

research_fields.failure_analysis: zone proliferation, hindsight, overlap, stale zones

cards.definition_principle: Research whether exact-contract premium response confirms an independently valid underlying setup after spread, Greeks, IV, and freshness checks.
measurable_predicates: exact CE/PE quote responds within fixed window
valid_conditions: Premium confirmation cannot rescue an invalid underlying thesis.
failure_conditions: Stale quote, wide spread, IV opposition, or missing Greeks.
contradictions: Greeks are guideposts and premium response is not guaranteed.
when_not_to_use: Never let the research card select or order a contract.
cards.paraphrase: Test premium confirmation as a separate capture lane after underlying validity.

research_fields.setup_logic: valid underlying setup precedes premium test
research_fields.trigger_logic: fresh premium response and spread pass
research_fields.failure_analysis: IV crush, theta, stale ask, selection bias

cards.definition_principle: Research whether pre-event IV/vega and post-event premium behavior identify contexts where long-option direction is overwhelmed by volatility repricing.
measurable_predicates: underlying move separated from IV move
valid_conditions: No event schedule or IV value is fabricated.
failure_conditions: IV history absent, contract rolls, or quote freshness fails.
contradictions: Vega is modeled sensitivity and does not alone forecast IV direction.
when_not_to_use: Never block or authorize a current trade from an unvalidated IV rule.
cards.exact_locator: Volatility and the Greeks > Vega paragraph
cards.paraphrase: Separate volatility repricing from direction and validate on exact-contract outcomes.

research_fields.setup_logic: long-option setup near known volatility event
research_fields.target_logic: natural target with after-cost premium outcome
research_fields.missing_data: authoritative IV history and outcome depth
research_fields.failure_analysis: event leakage, sparse samples, contract mismatch

cards.definition_principle: Research top-of-book event imbalance only after authoritative L2/order-event history exists; no proxy substitution is permitted.
valid_conditions: Event completeness and sequence gaps pass policy.
failure_conditions: Missing events, snapshot-only depth, or proxy volume/OI.
contradictions: Current production data is insufficient and source results do not transfer automatically.
when_not_to_use: Never use before future L2 policy and CITADEL OOS validation pass.
cards.exact_locator: Section 4.1 > Trade imbalance vs order flow imbalance
cards.paraphrase: Preserve this as future-data-dependent research with an explicit no-proxy rule.
